mechanics.claim: Event Horizon deals no damage; it only knocks down and stuns enemies who touch the cage edges.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that touch the cage edges are briefly {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}}.

mechanics.claim: Event Horizon can affect each enemy only once per cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Event Horizon'' can affect enemies only once per cast.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not on the cage's activation or expiry.
